recommendations.why: Checks whether two categorical fields are associated by comparing a cross-tabulation with the counts expected if unrelated. It uses region (categorical_u8, 4 groups) and plan (categorical_u8, 2 groups).

alternatives.when: the table is 2x2 and some expected counts are small
you compare a yes/no rate between exactly two groups and want a confidence interval
both fields are numeric
you compare one subgroup's mix with the whole population

follow_ups.when: the table shows an association and you want to see which cells drive it
